entries.description: A six-flag rubric and escalation ladder that a coding agent follows at dispatch time to route each unit of work to the cheapest model tier that passes objective verification. Free, MIT licensed. Install with `npx skills add undercutsh/firstpass`.
Source repository: the skill, the vendor-constant deterministic eval harness (evals/), and the raw public benchmark results (testing/).
Agent-facing navigation index: what Undercut is, when to use it, benchmark summary, and links to docs.

notes: No public API, MCP server, or agentic plugin exists yet — the free tier is a static policy file, not a running service. This catalog will grow when those ship; see https://getundercut.sh/#teams for what's in development.
